name: topology_register_model
description: Register or update an extensible custom model for the Multi-Model Council and Quota/Budget Tracker (supports gemini, anthropic, openai, openai_compatible, ollama providers).

name.description: Human-readable display name for the model

role.description: Council role / specialization (e.g. 'Synthesizer & Code Auditor', 'Domain Specialist')

avatar.description: Emoji or icon avatar representing the model

apiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable name containing the API key (e.g. 'DEEPSEEK_API_KEY', 'OPENAI_API_KEY')

rpmQuota.description: Requests Per Minute rate limit ceiling

tpmQuota.description: Tokens Per Minute throughput quota limit

costPer1kInput.description: Cost in USD per 1,000 prompt tokens

costPer1kOutput.description: Cost in USD per 1,000 completion tokens
